Changes.note: The question you ask stays with the celse you chose. Only you and those who may answer in this course see it: the course's hoca, the köşk nazımı, the başmüderris, a nazır given that right, and Medaris's başnazım. Other talebe do not see it, and nobody is notified. You can rewrite it until it is answered and delete it at any time; deleting it removes its answer too, and it cannot be undone.
